name: Mees SMP Lite
summary: Mees SMP Lite 0.4.0: voted-in farming, wildlife, furniture, Traveler's Backpack and Origins: Legacy, plus essential performance, maps, proximity voice chat and optional distant terrain rendering. Java Fabric 26.3; content mods require matching server deployment.

Vanilla-inspired craftable furniture and decor; required on server and client
Craftable wearable backpacks and portable storage; required on server and client
Fabric 26.3 compatible Origins port with origin powers and drawbacks; required on server and client
Configurable distant terrain LOD; client-side; disable for lower-spec PCs
